description: Database Latihan Buku Grammar Plus B1 (Sarah Jane Lewis) untuk Siswa Kelas XI & XII (Fase F)

units.title: to be: Jawaban singkat; There is / There are
units.english_title: to be: Short answers; There is / There are

grammar.summary: Kata kerja 'to be' (am, is, are) adalah dasar pembentukan kalimat dalam bahasa Inggris untuk menyatakan identitas, kondisi, sifat, serta keberadaan sesuatu menggunakan 'There is / There are'.

tables.title: Tabel Konjugasi To Be (Afirmatif, Negatif, Interogatif)

rules: Jawaban singkat (Short Answers): Ulangi kata ganti subjek dan kata kerja setelah Yes atau No. Contoh: 'Is she tired? Yes, she is. / No, she isn't.'

There is / There are: Digunakan untuk menyatakan keberadaan benda. Gunakan 'there is' untuk benda tunggal dan 'there are' untuk benda jamak. Contoh: 'There is a blackbird in the garden.', 'There are many trees in the park.'
Kalimat bahasa Inggris umumnya tidak dimulai dengan kata benda tak tentu ('A vase is on the table' kurang lazim, gunakan 'There is a vase on the table').
Struktur kalimat dengan kata tanya: Kata Tanya + to be + Subjek. Contoh: 'Where is the TV remote?', 'How are your grandparents?'

exercises.title: Latihan 1: Lengkapi dengan Bentuk Kata Kerja To Be yang Tepat
exercises.instruction: Ketik kata kerja to be yang tepat (am, is, are, aren't, isn't) untuk melengkapi kalimat berikut.

questions.q: 1. Francis [BLANK] my friend.
questions.explanation: Gunakan 'is' untuk subjek tunggal orang ketiga.

questions.q: 2. Sam and Mark [BLANK] brothers, they are cousins.
questions.hint: Kalimat bernada kontras: mereka bukan saudara kandung, melainkan sepupu.
questions.explanation: Gunakan bentuk negatif jamak 'aren't' atau 'are not'.

questions.q: 3. A: [BLANK] they French? B: No, they [BLANK2]. They [BLANK3] Spanish.
questions.hint: Pertanyaan untuk 'they', jawaban negatif singkat, dan afirmatif jamak.
questions.explanation: Pertanyaan: 'Are they French?', Jawaban: 'No, they aren't. They are Spanish.'

questions.q: 4. A: [BLANK] Joanne very hungry? B: No, I don't think she is.
questions.hint: Joanne adalah kata ganti orang ketiga tunggal (she).
questions.explanation: Kalimat tanya diawali 'Is' untuk subjek tunggal.

questions.q: 5. My son [BLANK] eight and my daughter [BLANK2] ten. They [BLANK3] at junior school now.
questions.explanation: Gunakan 'is' untuk anak tunggal dan 'are' untuk 'they'.

questions.q: 6. I [BLANK] not very confident at playing sport.
questions.explanation: Subjek 'I' selalu berpasangan dengan 'am'.

questions.q: 7. Where [BLANK] the children?
questions.explanation: Karena 'children' adalah jamak, gunakan 'are'.

questions.q: 8. Paul [BLANK] not very tall.
questions.explanation: Subjek tunggal menggunakan 'is'.

exercises.title: Latihan 2: Susun Kata Menjadi Kalimat dengan To Be
exercises.instruction: Ketik susunan kalimat yang benar dari kata-kata yang diacak.

questions.q: 1. we / to / going / aren't / today / the beach / ?
questions.answer: Aren't we going to the beach today?
alternateAnswers: Are not we going to the beach today?
questions.explanation: Susunan kalimat tanya negatif: Aren't + we + going to + the beach + today?

questions.q: 2. playing / they / in the play / the main roles / are
questions.answer: They are playing the main roles in the play.
alternateAnswers: They're playing the main roles in the play.
questions.explanation: Susunan afirmatif: Subjek + to be + verb-ing + objek + keterangan.

questions.q: 3. well / not / feeling / is / today / he / very
questions.answer: He is not feeling very well today.
alternateAnswers: He isn't feeling very well today.
questions.explanation: Susunan: He is not feeling very well today.

questions.q: 4. a bus / you / taking / to the airport / are / ?
questions.answer: Are you taking a bus to the airport?
questions.explanation: Pertanyaan present continuous: Are + you + taking + a bus to the airport?

questions.q: 5. cold / she / wearing / isn't / just / a T-shirt / ?
questions.answer: Isn't she cold wearing just a T-shirt?
questions.explanation: Susunan: Isn't she cold wearing just a T-shirt?

questions.q: 6. not / raining / is / very much / it / anymore
questions.answer: It is not raining very much anymore.
alternateAnswers: It isn't raining very much anymore.
questions.explanation: Susunan kalimat negatif: It is not raining very much anymore.

questions.q: 7. you / better / the operation / looking / are / after
questions.answer: You are looking better after the operation.
alternateAnswers: Are you looking better after the operation?
You're looking better after the operation.
questions.explanation: Susunan: You are looking better after the operation.

questions.q: 8. cinema / they / to / tonight / the / are / going / ?
questions.answer: Are they going to the cinema tonight?
questions.explanation: Susunan: Are they going to the cinema tonight?

exercises.title: Latihan 3: Ubah Kalimat Afirmatif Menjadi Negatif dan Tanya (Interogatif)
exercises.instruction: Ubah kalimat berikut menjadi bentuk negatif dan kalimat tanya (format: Negatif / Tanya?).

questions.q: 1. She is a nice woman.
questions.answer: She isn't a nice woman. / Is she a nice woman?
alternateAnswers: She is not a nice woman. / Is she a nice woman?
questions.hint: Bentuk negatif pakai isn't, tanya diawali Is.
questions.explanation: Negatif: She isn't a nice woman. Interogatif: Is she a nice woman?

questions.q: 2. They are firemen.
questions.answer: They aren't firemen. / Are they firemen?
alternateAnswers: They are not firemen. / Are they firemen?
questions.hint: Bentuk negatif pakai aren't, tanya diawali Are.
questions.explanation: Negatif: They aren't firemen. Interogatif: Are they firemen?

questions.q: 3. He is always on time for swimming lessons.
questions.answer: He isn't always on time for swimming lessons. / Is he always on time for swimming lessons?
alternateAnswers: He is not always on time for swimming lessons. / Is he always on time for swimming lessons?
questions.hint: Negatif dengan isn't, interogatif diawali Is he...
questions.explanation: Negatif: He isn't always on time for swimming lessons. Interogatif: Is he always on time for swimming lessons?

questions.q: 4. You are very organised.
questions.answer: You aren't very organised. / Are you very organised?
alternateAnswers: You are not very organised. / Are you very organised?
questions.explanation: Negatif: You aren't very organised. Interogatif: Are you very organised?

questions.q: 5. It is cold outside this evening.
questions.answer: It isn't cold outside this evening. / Is it cold outside this evening?
alternateAnswers: It is not cold outside this evening. / Is it cold outside this evening?
questions.explanation: Negatif: It isn't cold outside this evening. Interogatif: Is it cold outside this evening?

questions.q: 6. She is a computer programmer.
questions.answer: She isn't a computer programmer. / Is she a computer programmer?
alternateAnswers: She is not a computer programmer. / Is she a computer programmer?
questions.explanation: Negatif: She isn't a computer programmer. Interogatif: Is she a computer programmer?

exercises.title: Latihan 4: Dengarkan Naskah Audio (TR 2) dan Lengkapi Dialog
exercises.instruction: Ketik kata tanya yang tepat untuk melengkapi bagian kosong dialog antara Juan dan Kathy.

questions.q: Juan: Thanks. My name's Juan, by the way. (1) [BLANK]'s yours?
questions.explanation: Juan menanyakan nama Kathy: 'What's yours?' (Siapa nama Anda?)

questions.q: Juan: That's an unusual accent. (2) [BLANK] are you from?
questions.explanation: Pertanyaan asal: 'Where are you from?'

questions.q: Kathy: I'm from Bristol, in the UK. I'm here on holiday. And you? Juan: I'm from Portugal. Kathy: (3) [BLANK] are you here with?
questions.explanation: Pertanyaan teman seperjalanan: 'Who are you here with?'

questions.q: Kathy: (4) [BLANK] are those sketches? They're really good. Juan: Thanks! They're mine.
questions.explanation: Menanyakan kepemilikan: 'Whose are those sketches?' (Milik siapa sketsa-sketsa itu?)

questions.q: Kathy: (5) [BLANK] do you study? Juan: Art and design.
questions.explanation: Menanyakan jurusan kuliah: 'What do you study?'

exercises.title: Latihan 5: Lengkapi Awal Kalimat dengan Kata Tanya yang Tepat
exercises.instruction: Pilihlah salah satu kata tanya: what, why, who, how, which, whose, where.

questions.q: 1. [BLANK] colour is your hair?
questions.explanation: 'What colour' digunakan untuk menanyakan warna spesifik.

questions.q: 2. [BLANK] much is an ice cream?
questions.explanation: 'How much' digunakan untuk menanyakan harga suatu barang.

questions.q: 3. [BLANK] is that short man over there?
questions.explanation: 'Who' digunakan untuk menanyakan identitas orang.

questions.q: 4. [BLANK] is the university campus?
questions.explanation: 'Where' digunakan untuk menanyakan letak/lokasi.

questions.q: 5. [BLANK] jumper is this?
questions.explanation: 'Whose' menanyakan milik siapa barang tersebut.

questions.q: 6. [BLANK] are you crying?
questions.explanation: 'Why' menanyakan alasan seseorang menangis.

questions.q: 7. [BLANK] are your hobbies?
questions.explanation: 'What are your hobbies?' adalah bentuk baku menanyakan hobi.

questions.q: 8. [BLANK] dress do you prefer: the red one or the blue one?
questions.hint: Memilih di antara pilihan terbatas yang disebutkan.
questions.explanation: 'Which' digunakan ketika memilih salah satu dari pilihan yang terbatas (merah atau biru).

exercises.title: Latihan 6: Hubungkan Jawaban Singkat (a-f) dengan Pernyataannya
exercises.instruction: Pilih pasangan jawaban singkat yang tepat untuk setiap pertanyaan.

questions.q: 1. Is Maxine going to the Halloween party?
questions.explanation: Pertanyaan 'Is Maxine...' dijawab dengan kata ganti 'she'.

questions.q: 2. Are you in my Science class?
questions.explanation: Pertanyaan 'Are you...' dijawab dengan 'Yes, I am.'

questions.q: 3. Are Emma and Jason singing in the school concert?
questions.hint: Emma and Jason adalah subjek jamak (they).
questions.explanation: Subjek jamak orang ketiga dijawab dengan 'they are'.

questions.q: 4. Are you and Jeffrey going out for pizza?
questions.explanation: Pertanyaan kepada 'you and [someone]' dijawab dengan 'we'.

questions.q: 5. Is Michael speaking to you online now?
questions.explanation: Pertanyaan dengan subjek Michael (he) dijawab dengan 'he isn't'.

questions.q: 6. Is that your car parked in the street?
questions.explanation: Benda tunggal dijawab dengan kata ganti 'it is'.

exercises.title: Latihan 7: Tuliskan Jawaban Singkat yang Tepat untuk Pertanyaan Berikut
exercises.instruction: Pilihlah bentuk jawaban singkat yang gramatikal sesuai subjek kalimat.

questions.q: 1. Are you wearing jeans today?
options: Yes, I am. / No, I'm not.
Yes, you are. / No, you aren't.
Yes, he is. / No, he isn't.
questions.answer: Yes, I am. / No, I'm not.
questions.hint: Pertanyaan 'Are you' ditujukan ke diri Anda.
questions.explanation: Jawaban personal menggunakan 'Yes, I am.' atau 'No, I'm not.'

questions.q: 2. Are you a member of the athletics team?
options: Yes, I am. / No, I'm not.
Yes, we are. / No, we're not.
Yes, it is. / No, it isn't.
questions.answer: Yes, I am. / No, I'm not.
questions.explanation: Jawaban individu menggunakan 'Yes, I am.' atau 'No, I'm not.'

questions.q: 3. Are you going to Birmingham next week?
options: Yes, I am. / No, I'm not.
Yes, they are. / No, they aren't.
Yes, she is. / No, she isn't.
questions.answer: Yes, I am. / No, I'm not.
questions.explanation: Gunakan 'Yes, I am.' atau 'No, I'm not.'

questions.q: 4. Are your grandparents having dinner at your house tonight?
options: Yes, they are. / No, they aren't.
Yes, we are. / No, we aren't.
Yes, he is. / No, he isn't.
questions.answer: Yes, they are. / No, they aren't.
questions.explanation: Gunakan kata ganti 'they are' atau 'they aren't'.

questions.q: 5. Is your best friend a good singer?
options: Yes, he/she is. / No, he/she isn't.
Yes, they are. / No, they aren't.
Yes, I am. / No, I'm not.
questions.answer: Yes, he/she is. / No, he/she isn't.
questions.hint: Sahabat Anda adalah tunggal (he atau she).
questions.explanation: Gunakan 'he is' atau 'she is'.

questions.q: 6. Are your mother and father at work right now?
options: Yes, they are. / No, they aren't.
Yes, we are. / No, we aren't.
Yes, it is. / No, it isn't.
questions.answer: Yes, they are. / No, they aren't.
questions.hint: Mother and father adalah dua orang (they).
questions.explanation: Subjek jamak orang ketiga menggunakan 'they are' / 'they aren't'.

questions.q: 7. Is your school near the sea?
options: Yes, it is. / No, it isn't.
Yes, they are. / No, they aren't.
Yes, I am. / No, I'm not.
questions.answer: Yes, it is. / No, it isn't.
questions.explanation: Gunakan kata ganti 'it is' / 'it isn't'.

questions.q: 8. Is it your birthday today?
options: Yes, it is. / No, it isn't.
Yes, I am. / No, I'm not.
Yes, you are. / No, you aren't.
questions.answer: Yes, it is. / No, it isn't.
questions.explanation: Pertanyaan dengan 'Is it' dijawab dengan 'Yes, it is.' atau 'No, it isn't.'

exercises.title: Latihan 8: Isilah dengan There is atau There are
exercises.instruction: Ketik there is atau there are sesuai jumlah benda (tunggal atau jamak).

questions.q: 1. [BLANK] twenty students in my language class.
questions.explanation: Gunakan 'There are' untuk benda jamak (20 siswa).

questions.q: 2. [BLANK] five members in my favourite band.
questions.explanation: Gunakan 'There are' untuk benda jamak (5 anggota).

questions.q: 3. [BLANK] a beautiful sculpture in my next-door neighbour's garden.
questions.explanation: Gunakan 'There is' untuk benda tunggal yang diawali 'a'.

questions.q: 4. [BLANK] a few buses waiting at the station, but none are the right bus for me.
questions.explanation: Frasa 'a few buses' membutuhkan kata kerja jamak 'There are'.

questions.q: 5. [BLANK] only one egg left in the fridge.
questions.hint: 'only one egg' adalah satu butir telur (tunggal).
questions.explanation: Gunakan 'There is' untuk satu butir telur.

questions.q: 6. I like my town centre. [BLANK] two cinemas, a bowling alley and lots of great shops.
questions.hint: Merinci dua bioskop dan banyak toko (jamak).
questions.explanation: Karena merinci fasilitas jamak di awal frasa ('two cinemas'), gunakan 'There are'.

exercises.title: Latihan 9: Buat Kalimat Berdasarkan Gambar dengan There is atau There are
exercises.instruction: Ketik kalimat yang mendeskripsikan gambar berikut menggunakan there is atau there are.

questions.q: 1. Perhatikan gambar kamar berikut: [BLANK]
questions.answer: There are clothes on the bed.
alternateAnswers: There is a girl on the bed.
There are clothes on the bed
There are many clothes on the bed.
questions.hint: Gunakan 'There are clothes on the bed.' atau 'There is a girl on the bed.'
questions.explanation: Mendeskripsikan banyak pakaian yang berserakan di atas kasur atau seorang anak perempuan di atas kasur.

questions.q: 2. Perhatikan gambar antrean di ATM berikut: [BLANK]
questions.answer: There are people queuing at the cash machine.
alternateAnswers: There are people queuing at the ATM.
There are people waiting in line.
There are three people at the cash machine.
questions.hint: Gunakan 'There are people queuing at the cash machine.' (atau ATM)
questions.explanation: Mendeskripsikan orang-orang yang sedang antre mengambil uang di mesin ATM / cash machine.

questions.q: 3. Perhatikan gambar burung di ranting pohon berikut: [BLANK]
questions.answer: There is a bird on the branch.
alternateAnswers: There is a bird on the tree.
There is a bird in the tree.
There is a robin on the branch.
questions.hint: Gunakan 'There is a bird on the branch.'
questions.explanation: Mendeskripsikan seekor burung (tunggal) yang bertengger di dahan/ranting pohon.

questions.q: 4. Perhatikan gambar anak bermain ayunan berikut: [BLANK]
questions.answer: There is a girl on the swing.
alternateAnswers: There is a child on the swing.
There is a girl playing on the swing.
There is a girl on a swing.
questions.hint: Gunakan 'There is a girl on the swing.'
questions.explanation: Mendeskripsikan seorang anak perempuan yang sedang berayun di ayunan.

units.title: a / an; Bentuk jamak; Kata tunjuk

grammar.summary: Artikel tak tentu 'a' dan 'an' digunakan di depan kata benda tunggal yang dapat dihitung. Bentuk jamak kata benda umumnya dibentuk dengan menambahkan akhiran -s, -es, -ies, atau -ves. Kata tunjuk (demonstratives) this/these merujuk pada benda dekat, sedangkan that/those merujuk pada benda jauh.

tables.title: Tabel Aturan Artikel dan Kata Tunjuk
rows: 'a' sebelum bunyi konsonan (a dog, a unit). 'an' sebelum bunyi vokal (an hour, an actor).
'this' untuk benda tunggal dekat; 'these' untuk benda jamak dekat.
'that' untuk benda tunggal jauh; 'those' untuk benda jamak jauh.

tables.title: Perubahan Bentuk Jamak Kata Benda

rules: Penentuan 'a' atau 'an' didasarkan pada BUNYI pengucapan awal kata, bukan sekadar hurufnya. Contoh: 'a uniform' (karena diawali bunyi konsonan /juː/), 'an hour' (karena huruf h tidak dibunyikan).
Kata benda jamak dan kata benda tak dapat dihitung (uncountable) TIDAK BOLEH menggunakan artikel a/an.
Kata tunjuk dapat berdiri sendiri atau mendampingi kata benda / one / ones: 'This pen is hers. These blue hats are nicer than those ones.'

exercises.title: Latihan 1: Tuliskan a atau an di Depan Kata Berikut
exercises.instruction: Ketik a atau an sesuai dengan bunyi awal pengucapan kata.

questions.q: 1. [BLANK] angry man.
questions.explanation: 'angry' berbunyi vokal sehingga menggunakan 'an'.

questions.q: 2. [BLANK] open window.
questions.explanation: 'open' berbunyi vokal sehingga memakai 'an'.

questions.q: 3. [BLANK] English lesson.
questions.explanation: 'English' diawali vokal sehingga memakai 'an'.

questions.q: 4. [BLANK] nose.
questions.explanation: 'nose' diawali konsonan sehingga memakai 'a'.

questions.q: 5. [BLANK] door.
questions.explanation: 'door' diawali konsonan sehingga memakai 'a'.

questions.q: 6. [BLANK] uniform.
questions.explanation: Meskipun huruf awal 'u', bunyinya adalah /j/ (konsonan), jadi gunakan 'a uniform'.

questions.q: 7. [BLANK] interesting story.
questions.explanation: 'interesting' diawali bunyi vokal sehingga memakai 'an'.

questions.q: 8. [BLANK] can of fizzy drink.
questions.explanation: 'can' diawali bunyi konsonan sehingga memakai 'a'.

questions.q: 9. [BLANK] unusual animal.
questions.explanation: 'unusual' diawali bunyi vokal pendek /ʌ/, gunakan 'an'.

questions.q: 10. [BLANK] argument.
questions.explanation: 'argument' diawali vokal sehingga memakai 'an'.

questions.q: 11. [BLANK] smartphone.
questions.explanation: 'smartphone' berbunyi konsonan sehingga memakai 'a'.

questions.q: 12. [BLANK] old laptop.
questions.explanation: 'old' berbunyi vokal sehingga memakai 'an'.

exercises.title: Latihan 2: Susun Kata Menjadi Kalimat yang Tepat (Audio TR 3)
exercises.instruction: Ketik susunan kalimat yang gramatikal dengan tanda baca yang benar.

questions.q: 1. apple / always / after / eat / I / breakfast / an
questions.answer: I always eat an apple after breakfast.
questions.explanation: Susunan yang benar: 'I always eat an apple after breakfast.'

questions.q: 2. bought / book / my brother / an / about elephants / interesting
questions.answer: My brother bought an interesting book about elephants.
questions.hint: Subjek My brother + bought + an interesting book...
questions.explanation: Susunan: 'My brother bought an interesting book about elephants.'

questions.q: 3. singer / saw / a / in town / Maryanne / famous
questions.answer: Maryanne saw a famous singer in town.
questions.hint: Subjek Maryanne + saw + a famous singer...
questions.explanation: Susunan: 'Maryanne saw a famous singer in town.'

questions.q: 4. Italy / country / is / a / sunny
questions.explanation: Susunan: 'Italy is a sunny country.'

questions.q: 5. Max / fantastic / had / party / birthday / a
questions.answer: Max had a fantastic birthday party.
questions.hint: Subjek Max + had + a fantastic birthday party.
questions.explanation: Susunan: 'Max had a fantastic birthday party.'

questions.q: 6. packed lunch / I / a / usually / take / to school
questions.answer: I usually take a packed lunch to school.
questions.explanation: Susunan: 'I usually take a packed lunch to school.'

exercises.title: Latihan 3: Lengkapi Kalimat dengan Artikel Tak Tentu (a, an, atau - jika tidak perlu)
exercises.instruction: Ketik a, an, atau tanda minus (-) jika bagian tersebut tidak membutuhkan artikel.

questions.q: 1. I'd like [BLANK] bottle of water and some chocolate.
questions.hint: Bottle adalah kata benda tunggal yang dapat dihitung.
questions.explanation: Gunakan 'a' sebelum bottle.

questions.q: 2. The printer has run out of [BLANK] ink.
questions.hint: Ink (tinta) adalah kata benda tak dapat dihitung (uncountable).
questions.explanation: 'ink' tidak dapat dihitung sehingga tidak memakai artikel a/an (-).

questions.q: 3. He is [BLANK] vegetarian, you can't eat [BLANK2] meat at his house.
questions.hint: Vegetarian adalah sebutan orang tunggal, meat adalah daging (tak dapat dihitung).
questions.explanation: Gunakan 'a' untuk vegetarian dan tanda strip (-) untuk meat.

questions.q: 4. My neighbour is [BLANK] photographer. Let's ask him to take [BLANK2] shot of us.
questions.explanation: Gunakan 'a photographer' dan 'a shot'.

questions.q: 5. [BLANK] person who suffers from [BLANK2] claustrophobia does not like being in [BLANK3] small spaces.
questions.explanation: A person (tunggal), claustrophobia (tanpa artikel), small spaces (jamak tanpa artikel).

questions.q: 6. I'll give you [BLANK] hundred pounds if you can dive off the top diving board into the pool.
questions.explanation: Frasa baku jumlah: 'a hundred pounds'.

questions.q: 7. I'd like to buy [BLANK] computer but the one I like is [BLANK2] expensive model.
questions.explanation: 'a computer' dan 'an expensive model'.

questions.q: 8. I have [BLANK] fear of [BLANK2] heights.
questions.hint: a fear of (frasa baku), heights adalah bentuk jamak.
questions.explanation: 'a fear of heights' (heights jamak tanpa artikel).

questions.q: 9. I'm inviting [BLANK] group of friends for lunch tomorrow night.
questions.hint: Group adalah kata benda kumpulan tunggal.
questions.explanation: Gunakan 'a group of friends'.

questions.q: 10. I want [BLANK] assistant who can speak French.
questions.explanation: Gunakan 'an assistant'.

exercises.title: Latihan 4: Ubahlah Kalimat Berikut Menjadi Bentuk Jamak
exercises.instruction: Ketik kalimat bentuk jamak lengkap dengan perubahan subjek dan kata kerja.

questions.q: 1. A dog is an animal.
questions.hint: A dog -> Dogs, is -> are, an animal -> animals.
questions.explanation: Bentuk jamak: 'Dogs are animals.'

questions.q: 2. A potato is a vegetable.
questions.explanation: Bentuk jamak: 'Potatoes are vegetables.'

questions.q: 3. A leaf fell off the tree.
questions.explanation: Bentuk jamak kata benda berakhiran -f berubah menjadi -ves: 'Leaves fell off the tree.'

questions.q: 4. A pencil is like a pen.
questions.hint: Pencil -> pencils, is -> are, pen -> pens.
questions.explanation: Bentuk jamak: 'Pencils are like pens.'

questions.q: 5. A writer writes a book.
questions.hint: Writer -> writers, writes -> write, book -> books.
questions.explanation: Bentuk jamak: 'Writers write books.'

questions.q: 6. A garden usually has a bush.
questions.hint: Garden -> gardens, has -> have, bush -> bushes.
questions.explanation: Kata benda berakhiran -sh ditambah -es: 'Gardens usually have bushes.'

questions.q: 7. A party is a fun way to celebrate your birthday.
questions.answer: Parties are fun ways to celebrate birthdays.
alternateAnswers: Parties are a fun way to celebrate your birthday.
Parties are fun ways to celebrate your birthday.
questions.explanation: Bentuk jamak: 'Parties are fun ways to celebrate birthdays.'

questions.q: 8. A wish is a special dream.
questions.hint: Wish -> wishes, is -> are, dream -> dreams.
questions.explanation: Kata benda berakhiran -sh ditambah -es: 'Wishes are special dreams.'

exercises.title: Latihan 5: Tulis Ulang Kalimat Menjadi Bentuk Jamak (Kata Tunjuk & Benda)
exercises.instruction: Ubah kata tunjuk (this/that -> these/those) dan kata bendanya menjadi jamak.

questions.q: 1. This giraffe is taller than that tiger.
questions.answer: These giraffes are taller than those tigers.
questions.hint: This giraffe -> These giraffes, that tiger -> those tigers.
questions.explanation: Bentuk jamak: 'These giraffes are taller than those tigers.'

questions.q: 2. This house is bigger than that one.
questions.answer: These houses are bigger than those ones.
questions.hint: This house -> These houses, that one -> those ones.
questions.explanation: Bentuk jamak: 'These houses are bigger than those ones.'

questions.q: 3. This is a tasty cake.
questions.hint: This is -> These are, a tasty cake -> tasty cakes.
questions.explanation: Bentuk jamak: 'These are tasty cakes.'

questions.q: 4. That is an interesting painting.
questions.hint: That is -> Those are, an interesting painting -> interesting paintings.
questions.explanation: Bentuk jamak: 'Those are interesting paintings.'

questions.q: 5. This is a sad film.
questions.hint: This is -> These are, a sad film -> sad films.
questions.explanation: Bentuk jamak: 'These are sad films.'

questions.q: 6. That goat escaped from the field.
questions.answer: Those goats escaped from the field.
alternateAnswers: Those goats escaped from the fields.
questions.explanation: Bentuk jamak: 'Those goats escaped from the field.'

questions.q: 7. This is a bicycle and that is a motorbike.
questions.answer: These are bicycles and those are motorbikes.
questions.hint: This is -> These are, that is -> those are.
questions.explanation: Bentuk jamak: 'These are bicycles and those are motorbikes.'

questions.q: 8. That is a friendly dog.
questions.hint: That is -> Those are, a friendly dog -> friendly dogs.
questions.explanation: Bentuk jamak: 'Those are friendly dogs.'

exercises.title: Latihan 6: Pilihlah Bentuk Kata Tunjuk yang Tepat
exercises.instruction: Pilihlah salah satu kata tunjuk yang tepat sesuai konteks tunggal/jamak dan jarak.

questions.q: 1. Are [BLANK] your trainers? I found them in the changing room.
questions.explanation: Gunakan 'these' karena 'trainers' berbentuk jamak.

questions.q: 2. [BLANK] bread is out-of-date. Throw it in the bin.
questions.hint: Bread adalah kata benda tak dapat dihitung (diperlakukan tunggal).
questions.explanation: 'bread' adalah uncountable noun tunggal, sehingga memakai 'That'.

questions.q: 3. What do you think of [BLANK] earrings over there?
questions.hint: Frasa 'over there' menandakan letak jauh dan earrings jamak.
questions.explanation: Gunakan 'those' untuk benda jamak di kejauhan ('over there').

questions.q: 4. [BLANK] exercise is easy.
questions.explanation: Gunakan 'This' untuk kata benda tunggal.

questions.q: 5. [BLANK] are my notes I took in class.
questions.explanation: Gunakan 'These' yang berpasangan dengan 'are'.

questions.q: 6. No, [BLANK] isn't my coat over there by the front door. Mine is blue.
questions.hint: Terdapat keterangan jarak jauh: 'over there by the front door'.
questions.explanation: Gunakan 'that' untuk merujuk benda tunggal yang jauh.

questions.q: 7. [BLANK] are my cakes on the table which I baked for the charity bake sale.
questions.hint: Cakes adalah jamak dan dipasangkan dengan 'are'.
questions.explanation: Gunakan 'Those' karena kata bendanya 'cakes' (jamak).

questions.q: 8. Hello everyone! I'm Jonathan and [BLANK] is my friend, Alicia.
questions.hint: Memperkenalkan orang di sebelah kita menggunakan 'this is...'
questions.explanation: Rumus baku memperkenalkan seseorang di samping penutur adalah 'this is my friend...'

exercises.title: Latihan 7: Dengarkan Rekaman Audio (TR 4) dan Pilih Kalimat yang Terdengar
exercises.instruction: Pilihlah opsi (a atau b) yang sesuai dengan kalimat pada audio rekaman.

questions.q: 1. Rekaman Nomor 1:
options: This is a photo of my family.
That is a photo of my family.
questions.answer: This is a photo of my family.
questions.hint: Perhatikan kata tunjuk yang diucapkan pembicara.
questions.explanation: Naskah audio TR 4 menyatakan: 'This is a photo of my family.'

questions.q: 2. Rekaman Nomor 2:
questions.hint: Perhatikan bentuk tunggal atau jamak dari mushroom.
questions.explanation: Naskah audio TR 4 menyatakan: 'I don't like these mushrooms.'

questions.q: 3. Rekaman Nomor 3:
options: How did you find those gloves?
How did you find these gloves?
questions.answer: How did you find those gloves?
questions.explanation: Naskah audio TR 4 menyatakan: 'How did you find those gloves?'

questions.q: 4. Rekaman Nomor 4:
questions.hint: Dengarkan whether pembicara mengatakan That atau This.
questions.explanation: Naskah audio TR 4 menyatakan: 'That is a big room.'

questions.q: 5. Rekaman Nomor 5:
options: I'm going to read these books on holiday.
I'm going to read this book on holiday.
questions.answer: I'm going to read these books on holiday.
questions.explanation: Naskah audio TR 4 menyatakan: 'I'm going to read these books on holiday.'

questions.q: 6. Rekaman Nomor 6:
options: Those jeans over there are really cheap.
These jeans over there are really cheap.
questions.answer: Those jeans over there are really cheap.
questions.explanation: Naskah audio TR 4 menyatakan: 'Those jeans over there are really cheap.'

questions.q: 7. Rekaman Nomor 7:
questions.hint: Perhatikan apakah jam tangan tunggal atau jamak.
questions.explanation: Naskah audio TR 4 menyatakan: 'This watch is expensive.'

questions.q: 8. Rekaman Nomor 8:
questions.explanation: Naskah audio TR 4 menyatakan: 'Are these seats taken?'

exercises.title: Latihan 8: Dengarkan Pertanyaan Audio (TR 5) dan Pilih Jawaban yang Tepat
exercises.instruction: Pilihlah respon jawaban yang paling tepat secara gramatikal terhadap pertanyaan audio.

questions.q: 1. Audio: 'Where are these men from?'
questions.hint: Subjek these men (orang) dijawab dengan They're.
questions.explanation: 'They're' adalah singkatan 'They are' yang merujuk pada asal usul pria-pria tersebut.

questions.q: 2. Audio: 'Is this book his?'
questions.explanation: Pertanyaan 'Is this book...' dijawab dengan 'Yes, it is.'

questions.q: 3. Audio: 'Are you students at this university?'
questions.hint: Pertanyaan ditujukan kepada Anda sekalian (you plural).
questions.explanation: Pertanyaan kepada 'you' jamak dijawab dengan 'No, we aren't.'

questions.q: 4. Audio: 'What shall I do with my shoes?'
options: Put them by the door over there.
questions.answer: Put them by the door over there.
questions.hint: Pertanyaan meminta instruksi tindakan ('What shall I do...?').
questions.explanation: Respon terhadap instruksi adalah kalimat perintah: 'Put them by the door over there.'

questions.q: 5. Audio: 'Do you like that pasta I made?'
questions.hint: Pertanyaan dengan 'Do you...' dijawab dengan 'Yes, I do.'
questions.explanation: Bentuk jawaban singkat baku dalam bahasa Inggris adalah 'Yes, I do.' (bukan 'Yes, I like').

exercises.title: Latihan 9: Perbaiki Kesalahan Tata Bahasa dalam Kalimat Berikut
exercises.instruction: Ketik kalimat yang sudah diperbaiki kesalahannya.

questions.q: 1. I am doing an unit in my exercise book.
questions.answer: I am doing a unit in my exercise book.
questions.explanation: Gunakan 'a unit' bukan 'an unit'.

questions.q: 2. Those is a great car.
questions.explanation: Gunakan 'That is a great car.' karena bendanya tunggal.

questions.q: 3. My favourite snack is apples.
alternateAnswers: My favourite snack is an apple.
questions.hint: Sesuaikan subjek dan predikat (snacks are apples atau snack is an apple).
questions.explanation: Bentuk koreksi: 'My favourite snacks are apples.' atau 'My favourite snack is an apple.'

questions.q: 4. Is this my memory stick over there?
questions.answer: Is that my memory stick over there?
questions.hint: Keterangan jarak 'over there' membutuhkan kata tunjuk jauh.
questions.explanation: Gunakan 'that' untuk letak yang jauh ('over there').

questions.q: 5. I like that people very much.
questions.answer: I like those people very much.
questions.explanation: Karena 'people' adalah jamak, gunakan 'those people'.

questions.q: 6. We don't need to wear an uniform to school.
questions.answer: We don't need to wear a uniform to school.
questions.explanation: Gunakan 'a uniform'.

questions.q: 7. My sister is coming in a hour.
questions.answer: My sister is coming in an hour.
questions.hint: 'hour' diawali bunyi vokal /aʊ/ karena h tidak berbunyi.
questions.explanation: Gunakan 'an hour' karena h tidak dilafalkan.

questions.q: 8. These exercises is helpful.
questions.explanation: Gunakan 'These exercises are helpful.' atau 'This exercise is helpful.'

questions.q: 9. Put the knifes and forks on the table, please.
questions.answer: Put the knives and forks on the table, please.
questions.hint: Bentuk jamak dari knife adalah knives (akhiran -ves).
questions.explanation: Bentuk jamak kata benda 'knife' adalah 'knives'.

questions.q: 10. My mother is teacher.
questions.hint: Profesi/pekerjaan tunggal wajib disertai artikel a/an.
questions.explanation: Wajib menggunakan artikel: 'My mother is a teacher.'

grammar.summary: Artikel tertentu 'the' (Definite Article) digunakan untuk membicarakan sesuatu yang spesifik, telah dibicarakan sebelumnya, atau benda yang hanya ada satu (unik). 'The' tidak digunakan ketika membicarakan hal-hal umum secara luas.

tables.title: Perbedaan Penggunaan 'The' (Definit) vs 'A/An' (Tak Tentu)
Kapan Harus Menggunakan dan Tidak Menggunakan 'The'
rows: Benda unik di alam semesta: the moon, the sun, the sky
Sebelum nama olahraga / permainan: play football, play chess
Sebelum alat musik setelah kata kerja play: play the piano
Sebelum nama gelar resmi tanpa nama: Captain Hook
Sebelum nama keluarga: the Smiths, the Browns
Sebelum nama danau dan satu gunung: Lake Michigan, Mount Everest
Sebelum sungai, laut, dan samudra: the Thames, the Atlantic
Sebelum nama negara tunggal: Italy, Japan, France, Indonesia
Sebelum negara perserikatan/jamak: the USA, the UK, the Netherlands
Sebelum waktu makan umum: have breakfast, what's for dinner?
Sebelum superlatif & ordinal: the best, the first, the only
Sebelum kata benda jamak yang merujuk hal umum: Rabbits are cute

rules: Gunakan 'the' jika mitra tutur sudah mengetahui benda mana yang dimaksud secara spesifik: 'Brian wants the action DVD.', 'I want the jumper you showed me.'
Jangan gunakan 'the' ketika membicarakan kategori secara umum: 'Italians love to eat well.' (bukan The Italians), 'Rabbits are faster than turtles.'
Penempatan: 'the' diletakkan sebelum kata benda, kata sifat, atau kata penentu jumlah: 'the tigers', 'the scary tigers', 'the four tigers'.

exercises.title: Latihan 1: Isilah dengan 'the' Ketika Diperlukan (atau '-' jika tidak perlu)
exercises.instruction: Ketik the atau tanda strip (-) jika kalimat tersebut tidak memerlukan artikel definit.

questions.q: 1. [BLANK] life is very easy for them at the moment.
questions.explanation: Membicarakan konsep hidup secara umum tidak memakai 'the'.

questions.q: 2. [BLANK] oranges I bought were very cheap.
questions.explanation: Spesifik merujuk buah jeruk yang dibeli penutur, gunakan 'The'.

questions.q: 3. We went to a Chinese restaurant last night and [BLANK] food was excellent.
questions.hint: Makanan di restoran yang baru saja dikunjungi (spesifik).
questions.explanation: Gunakan 'the' karena merujuk makanan spesifik di restoran itu.

questions.q: 4. They play [BLANK] football very well.
questions.hint: Nama cabang olahraga tidak memakai the.
questions.explanation: Olahraga seperti 'football' tidak menggunakan artikel.

questions.q: 5. The party was fun but I didn't enjoy [BLANK] music.
questions.explanation: Merujuk musik di pesta tersebut secara definit, gunakan 'the'.

questions.q: 6. I don't like the smell of [BLANK] Brussels sprouts.
questions.explanation: Merujuk jenis sayur secara umum, tidak memakai artikel.

questions.q: 7. They don't believe in [BLANK] ghosts.
questions.explanation: Konsep hantu secara umum tidak menggunakan 'the'.

questions.q: 8. I was [BLANK] first person down for breakfast this morning.
questions.explanation: Ordinal numbers selalu memakai 'the first'.

questions.q: 9. He dropped [BLANK] glass on [BLANK2] floor.
questions.explanation: Gunakan 'the' (atau 'a' untuk glass) dan 'the floor'.

questions.q: 10. This is [BLANK] fastest car I've ever driven.
questions.explanation: Bentuk superlatif selalu memakai 'the fastest'.

questions.q: 11. Does she play [BLANK] piano well?
questions.hint: Alat musik setelah kata kerja play wajib memakai the.
questions.explanation: Nama instrumen musik setelah play menggunakan 'the piano'.

questions.q: 12. [BLANK] sun was shining in [BLANK2] sky.
questions.hint: Matahari dan langit adalah benda unik di alam.
questions.explanation: Benda unik menggunakan 'The sun' dan 'the sky'.

questions.q: 13. This is [BLANK] only pair of sunglasses I own.
questions.explanation: Frasa definit: 'the only pair'.

questions.q: 14. I buy '[BLANK] Times' newspaper every Saturday.
questions.hint: Nama surat kabar terkenal memakai the.
questions.explanation: Nama koran pers memakai 'the Times'.

questions.q: 15. I'm going on holiday in [BLANK] June.
questions.explanation: Nama bulan (June) tidak menggunakan artikel.

questions.q: 16. [BLANK] water boils at 100° C.
questions.explanation: Pernyataan sains tentang zat umum tidak menggunakan 'the'.

questions.q: 17. Sometimes it's difficult to find [BLANK] time to do [BLANK2] things you like.
questions.hint: Waktu yang tepat dan hal-hal yang disukai.
questions.explanation: Gunakan 'the time' dan 'the things you like'.

questions.q: 18. I'd like to visit [BLANK] Japan and [BLANK2] USA.
questions.hint: Japan negara tunggal (-), USA negara perserikatan (the).
questions.explanation: Negara bukan kesatuan tanpa artikel (-), sedangkan serikat memakai 'the USA'.

exercises.title: Latihan 2: Buat Kalimat dengan Menggunakan Kata yang Tersedia (Audio TR 6)
exercises.instruction: Ketik kalimat yang lengkap dengan penambahan artikel the yang tepat.

questions.q: 1. furniture / your house / beautiful
questions.answer: The furniture in your house is beautiful.
questions.hint: The furniture in your house is...
questions.explanation: Susunan yang benar: 'The furniture in your house is beautiful.'

questions.q: 2. where / sugar?
questions.explanation: Susunan: 'Where is the sugar?'

questions.q: 3. glasses / table / his
questions.answer: His glasses are on the table.
alternateAnswers: The glasses on the table are his.
questions.hint: His glasses are on the table.
questions.explanation: Berdasarkan audio TR 6: 'His glasses are on the table.'

questions.q: 4. where / teachers?
questions.explanation: Susunan: 'Where are the teachers?'

questions.q: 5. for you / fruit and vegetables / healthy
questions.answer: Fruit and vegetables are healthy for you.
questions.explanation: Buah dan sayur umum tidak memakai the: 'Fruit and vegetables are healthy for you.'

questions.q: 6. parks / my city / beautiful
questions.answer: The parks in my city are beautiful.
questions.hint: The parks in my city are...
questions.explanation: Susunan: 'The parks in my city are beautiful.'

questions.q: 7. weather / today! / nice
questions.explanation: Susunan: 'The weather is nice today!'

questions.q: 8. my brother / sister-in-law / Amsterdam / live
questions.answer: My brother and my sister-in-law live in Amsterdam.
alternateAnswers: My brother and sister-in-law live in Amsterdam.
questions.hint: My brother and my sister-in-law live in...
questions.explanation: Susunan: 'My brother and my sister-in-law live in Amsterdam.'

questions.q: 9. students / classroom / in
questions.answer: The students are in the classroom.
questions.explanation: Susunan: 'The students are in the classroom.'

questions.q: 10. smaller fish / sharks / eat
questions.explanation: Ikan hiu secara umum: 'Sharks eat smaller fish.'

exercises.title: Latihan 3: Perbaiki Kalimat Berikut Jika Diperlukan
exercises.instruction: Ketik kalimat yang benar. Jika kalimat aslinya sudah benar, ketik 'Correct'.

questions.q: 1. What do you usually have for breakfast?
questions.explanation: Kalimat sudah benar karena 'for breakfast' tidak memakai artikel.

questions.q: 2. Do you watch news every day?
questions.answer: Do you watch the news every day?
questions.hint: Siaran berita di televisi menggunakan 'the news'.
questions.explanation: Tambahkan the: 'Do you watch the news every day?'

questions.q: 3. I love cakes, but cakes my wife makes are really special.
questions.answer: I love cakes, but the cakes my wife makes are really special.
questions.explanation: Gunakan 'the cakes my wife makes' karena merujuk kue spesifik.

questions.q: 4. When I was a child I visited the France, the Germany, and the Netherlands.
questions.answer: When I was a child I visited France, Germany, and the Netherlands.
questions.hint: France dan Germany tidak memakai the, Netherlands tetap memakai the.
questions.explanation: Hilangkan 'the' di depan France dan Germany.

questions.q: 5. Sweaters in that shop are expensive.
questions.answer: The sweaters in that shop are expensive.
questions.hint: Baju hangat di toko tersebut spesifik.
questions.explanation: Tambahkan 'The': 'The sweaters in that shop are expensive.'

questions.q: 6. Mum is listening to music and Dad is in the garden.
questions.hint: Music umum tanpa the, the garden benar.
questions.explanation: Kalimat sudah tepat ('Correct').

questions.q: 7. The fizzy drinks in the fridge are really cold.
questions.explanation: Kalimat sudah tepat ('Correct').

questions.q: 8. The birds love to eat the seeds.
alternateAnswers: Birds love to eat the seeds.
The birds love to eat seeds.
questions.hint: Burung dan biji-bijian secara umum tidak memakai the.
questions.explanation: Pernyataan umum: 'Birds love to eat seeds.'

questions.q: 9. I have some meat and fish in the fridge. The meat is fine, but fish isn't fresh.
questions.answer: I have some meat and fish in the fridge. The meat is fine, but the fish isn't fresh.
questions.hint: Ikan yang kedua sudah spesifik merujuk ikan di kulkas.
questions.explanation: Tambahkan 'the' di depan fish: '...but the fish isn't fresh.'

questions.q: 10. I enjoy the tennis but I prefer playing cards.
questions.answer: I enjoy tennis but I prefer playing cards.
questions.explanation: Hilangkan the sebelum tennis: 'I enjoy tennis but I prefer playing cards.'

exercises.title: Latihan 4: Tulis Kalimat dengan Menggunakan Artikel 'the'
exercises.instruction: Susun kata-kata berikut menjadi kalimat lengkap dengan menyisipkan artikel 'the' yang tepat.

questions.q: 1. Mike / took trip / to USA
questions.answer: Mike took a trip to the USA.
questions.hint: Mike took a trip to the USA.
questions.explanation: Gunakan 'a trip' dan 'the USA'.

questions.q: 2. Paul and Hannah / in / same class
questions.answer: Paul and Hannah are in the same class.
questions.explanation: Ordinal/identitas sama memakai 'the same class'.

questions.q: 3. Megan / plays / keyboard
questions.explanation: Instrumen musik memakai 'the keyboard'.

questions.q: 4. Louise / went / boat ride / on River Thames
questions.answer: Louise went on a boat ride on the River Thames.
questions.explanation: Nama sungai memakai artikel: 'the River Thames'.

questions.q: 5. When / start / marathon race / ?
questions.answer: When does the marathon race start?
alternateAnswers: When will the marathon race start?
questions.hint: When does the marathon race start?
questions.explanation: Lomba maraton spesifik memakai 'the marathon race'.

questions.q: 6. Where / papers / had / on my desk / ?
questions.answer: Where are the papers I had on my desk?
questions.explanation: Kertas spesifik di atas meja memakai 'the papers'.

questions.q: 7. These / jeans / only / ones / fit me
questions.answer: These jeans are the only ones that fit me.
questions.explanation: Kata only didahului the: 'the only ones'.

questions.q: 8. Police / have / important job
questions.answer: The police have an important job.
questions.hint: The police have an important job.
questions.explanation: Kepolisian sebagai institusi memakai 'The police'.

exercises.title: Latihan 5: Tambahkan a, an atau the Jika Diperlukan (atau '-' jika tidak perlu)
exercises.instruction: Ketik a, an, the, atau tanda strip (-) pada setiap bagian kosong yang tersedia.

questions.q: 1. [BLANK] children love [BLANK2] ice cream.
questions.hint: Anak-anak dan es krim secara umum.
questions.explanation: Pernyataan umum tentang anak dan es krim tanpa artikel (- / -).

questions.q: 2. [BLANK] vegetables are healthy.
questions.explanation: Pernyataan umum sayuran tanpa artikel (-).

questions.q: 3. I want [BLANK] glass of [BLANK2] milk.
questions.explanation: Gunakan 'a glass of milk' (susu uncountable tanpa artikel).

questions.q: 4. [BLANK] door of [BLANK2] garage is broken.
questions.explanation: Gunakan 'The door of the garage'.

questions.q: 5. Can you play [BLANK] violin?
questions.explanation: Gunakan 'the violin'.

questions.q: 6. Do you prefer [BLANK] romantic book or [BLANK2] book about adventures?
questions.hint: Satu buku romantis atau satu buku petualangan.
questions.explanation: Keduanya benda tunggal tak tentu: 'a romantic book or a book...'

questions.q: 7. Jack and Jill went up [BLANK] hill to get [BLANK2] bucket of water.
questions.explanation: Gunakan 'the hill' dan 'a bucket of water'.

questions.q: 8. He took up swimming as [BLANK] hobby [BLANK2] last year.
questions.explanation: Gunakan 'a hobby' dan 'last year' tanpa artikel (-).

questions.q: 9. [BLANK] butcher opposite [BLANK2] library always sells [BLANK3] good meat.
questions.hint: Toko daging seberang perpustakaan, daging berkualitas baik.
questions.explanation: 'The butcher opposite the library always sells good meat.'

questions.q: 10. [BLANK] birds can fly very high in [BLANK2] sky.
questions.explanation: Burung umum tanpa artikel (-), langit memakai 'the sky'.

questions.q: 11. There is [BLANK] fly in my glass of water.
questions.explanation: Gunakan 'a fly'.

questions.q: 12. Take [BLANK] umbrella with you to [BLANK2] office. It looks like rain.
questions.explanation: Gunakan 'an umbrella' dan 'the office'.

questions.q: 13. We had [BLANK] meal at [BLANK2] new restaurant [BLANK3] last night.
questions.hint: Makan di sebuah restoran baru kemarin malam.
questions.explanation: 'a meal at a new restaurant last night'.

questions.q: 14. I am fond of [BLANK] tea with [BLANK2] lemon.
questions.hint: Teh dan lemon sebagai minuman umum.
questions.explanation: Teh dengan lemon secara umum tidak memakai artikel (- / -).

questions.q: 15. [BLANK] clouds over [BLANK2] sea are looking very grey.
questions.hint: Awan dan laut spesifik yang sedang dilihat.
questions.explanation: 'The clouds over the sea are looking very grey.'

questions.q: 16. It is nice to play [BLANK] game of [BLANK2] tennis on [BLANK3] summer afternoon.
questions.hint: Satu permainan tenis di suatu sore musim panas.
questions.explanation: 'a game of tennis on a summer afternoon'.

exercises.title: Latihan 6: Perbaiki Wacana dengan Menghilangkan 'the' yang Tidak Perlu
exercises.instruction: Baca wacana tentang hobi berenang berikut, lalu ketik wacana yang sudah diperbaiki tanpa kata 'the' yang salah.

questions.q:
Wacana asli:
"I like the tennis. I'm also very good at the swimming, but I don't like the swimming pools very much because there are always too many people there. But the swimming pool near our house is very nice. I often go there on the Saturday mornings. I meet my friends and we have the lunch at the cafeteria after we swim. I usually have a sandwich. There is also a big glass window in the cafeteria, and you can watch the swimmers while you eat."

Ketik paragraf hasil perbaikan di bawah:
questions.answer: I like tennis. I'm also very good at swimming, but I don't like swimming pools very much because there are always too many people there. But the swimming pool near our house is very nice. I often go there on Saturday mornings. I meet my friends and we have lunch at the cafeteria after we swim. I usually have a sandwich. There is also a big glass window in the cafeteria, and you can watch the swimmers while you eat.
questions.hint: Hilangkan kata 'the' sebelum kata: tennis, swimming, swimming pools, Saturday mornings, lunch.
questions.explanation: Aturan: Nama olahraga (tennis, swimming), benda jamak umum (swimming pools), hari (Saturday mornings), dan waktu makan (lunch) tidak boleh memakai artikel 'the'.

grammar.summary: Materi pembahasan komprehensif untuk one / ones (Pronoun Substitutes: one / ones) pada halaman 13 buku Grammar Plus B1.

tables.title: Ikhtisar Topik: Pronoun Substitutes: one / ones
rows: CEFR B1 (Tingkat XI & XII - Fase F)

rules: Unit ini membahas mendalam mengenai kaidah penggunaan Pronoun Substitutes: one / ones.
Penyusunan modul latihan interaktif untuk unit ini sedang dipersiapkan dan segera dirilis.

Juan: Excuse me. Is this seat taken?
Kathy: No, go ahead and sit down.
Juan: Thanks. My name's Juan, by the way. What's yours?
Kathy: Oh hi! Nice to meet you. I'm Kathy.
Juan: That's an unusual accent. Where are you from?
Kathy: I'm from Bristol, in the UK. I'm here on holiday. And you?
Juan: I'm from Portugal.
Kathy: Who are you here with?
Juan: Just some friends from university. We're doing some research for a project.
Kathy: Whose are those sketches? They're really good.
Juan: Thanks! They're mine. I'm drawing some pictures of the famous paintings here.
Kathy: What do you study?
Juan: Art and design.
Kathy: That sounds cool.
Juan: Well, enjoy your holiday Kathy.
Kathy: OK, thank you. It was nice speaking to you. Bye!
